claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Didanosine is a purine nucleoside analog that requires intracellular phosphorylation; at 2.5 uM over 5 days it is expected to produce little or no cytotoxicity because its active triphosphate is a weak chain terminator and its main annotated target PNP inhibition does not directly kill cells.
